text:
```yaml
name: Publish Extension to Marketplace
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/extension-publish-marketplace.yml'
      - '.github/agents/**'
      - '.github/prompts/**'
      - '.github/instructions/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'
      - 'README.md'
      - 'LICENSE'
      - '.vscode/**'
      - '.vscodeignore'
      - 'src/**'
      - 'dist/**'
      - '*.ps1'
      - '*.psd1'
      - '*.psm1'
      - '*.yml'
      - '*.yaml'
jobs:
  publish-extension:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Validate Package
        run: npm run validate:package

      - name: Build Extension
        run: npm run build

      - name: Publish to Visual Studio Marketplace
        uses: HikariAssistant/vscode-marketplace@v0.1.0
        with:
          marketplace: 'visualstudio'
          publisher: 'microsoft'
          extension-id: 'hve-core'
          version: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          package-path: './dist/hve-core.vsix'
          token: ${{ secrets.VSCE_PAT }}
```
